bodyEn: Arsenal have opened talks with Bayer Leverkusen over a move for Jarell Quansah as they intensify efforts to bring in cover for William Saliba and Jurriën Timber.

The England defender, who left Liverpool last summer for an initial £30m and was part of Thomas Tuchel’s World Cup squad, has been identified as an ideal replacement for the France and Netherlands defenders, who will miss the start of the new season due to injury. While Quansah’s preferred position is in central defence, he was also deployed at right-back by Tuchel at the World Cup and was sent off in the last-16 victory over Mexico.

It is understood that Leverkusen are reluctant to sell the 23-year-old, who signed a five-year deal when he left Anfield last July, and would want at least €50m (£43m). Arsenal – who saw a bid of £30m for Aston Villa’s Ezri Konsa rejected earlier in the window – are not thought to want to pay that much but now could test the German club’s resolve by submitting a similar offer. Liverpool had a €70m buyback option on Quansah but that has now expired.
Arsenal are still believed to be interested in Konsa, who also filled in at right-back for England during the World Cup but is better known as a central defender. Villa value the 28-year-old at £60m.

Mikel Arteta said this week that Saliba’s back injury would take “some time to heal” and he was unsure about when he would be available again. Arsenal also have concerns over Timber, who pulled out of the Netherlands squad on the eve of the World Cup after failing to recover from a persistent groin injury that forced him to miss most of the run‑in last season.

“Jurriën is progressing really well,” Arteta said after Arsenal’s friendly defeat by Borussia Dortmund last weekend. “He’s on the pitch, he’s doing quite a lot right now, but it’s still weeks away. I cannot tell you how much.”

Arsenal would still like to sign a new attacker before the end of the window and could allow Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus to depart in order to free up more funds. Galatasaray have offered £38m for Martinelli, although the Brazil forward is not thought to be keen on a move to Turkey. Napoli have shown an interest in Jesus.
Ethan Nwaneri could also be sold, with Milan, Fulham, RB Leipzig and Borussia Dortmund among those who have been linked with the 19-year-old.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳就签下贾雷尔·昆萨与勒沃库森展开谈判
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳已就签下昆萨与勒沃库森谈判，德甲球队要价至少5000万欧，枪手仍有意维拉后卫孔萨。
bodyZh: 阿森纳已就引进贾雷尔·昆萨与勒沃库森展开谈判，他们正加紧为威廉·萨利巴和尤里安·廷贝尔寻找替补。
这位英格兰后卫去年夏天以3000万英镑的初始转会费离开利物浦，并入选了托马斯·图赫尔的世界杯大名单。他被视为法国和荷兰后卫的理想替代者，后者因伤将缺席新赛季开局。昆萨的首选位置是中卫，但图赫尔在世界杯上也让他客串右后卫，并在16强战胜墨西哥的比赛中被红牌罚下。
据了解，勒沃库森不愿出售这位23岁的球员，他去年7月离开安菲尔德时签下了一份五年合同，而德甲俱乐部希望至少得到5000万欧元（4300万英镑）。阿森纳在转会窗口早些时候以3000万英镑报价阿斯顿维拉的埃兹里·孔萨遭拒，据信他们不想支付那么多，但如今可能会以类似的报价来考验这家德国俱乐部的决心。利物浦曾对昆萨拥有7000万欧元的回购条款，但现在已过期。
据信阿森纳仍对孔萨感兴趣，他在世界杯上也曾为英格兰客串右后卫，但更出名的是中卫角色。维拉对这位28岁球员的估价为6000万英镑。
米克尔·阿尔特塔本周表示，萨利巴的背伤需要“一段时间才能痊愈”，他不确定后者何时能复出。阿森纳也对廷贝尔感到担忧，后者在世界杯前夕因未能从腹股沟伤势中恢复而退出荷兰队，这一伤势使他缺席了上赛季大部分收官阶段比赛。
“尤里安恢复得非常好，”阿尔特塔在上周末阿森纳友谊赛负于多特蒙德后表示。“他已经回到场上，现在做了不少事，但还需要几周时间。具体多久我无法告诉你。”
阿森纳仍希望在转会窗口关闭前签下一名新攻击手，并可能允许加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯离队，以腾出更多资金。加拉塔萨雷已为马丁内利报价3800万英镑，不过这位巴西前锋据信并不热衷于转会土耳其。那不勒斯对热苏斯表示了兴趣。
伊桑·恩瓦内里也可能被出售，AC米兰、富勒姆、RB莱比锡和多特蒙德等俱乐部都与这位19岁小将传出绯闻。

新闻简报推广之后。
迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利的未来尚不明朗，本周他被推荐给了切尔西和曼联。阿尔特塔在周三对阵法布雷加斯执教的科莫的友谊赛中进球后，拒绝回应这些传闻。“我不会谈论猜测，”他说。“如果有关于我们球员的猜测，那是个好迹象。这意味着我们的球员吸引了关注，而且表现不错。”

items.summaryEn: Everyone at the club is saddened to hear about the passing of our former goalkeeper, who played 146 games for us in the mid-1970s.
bodyEn: Everyone at the club is saddened to hear about the passing of our former goalkeeper Jimmy Rimmer.
Jimmy played 146 games for us and was crowned our Player of the Year in 1975 after succeeding the legendary Bob Wilson as our No. 1.

An unused substitute when Manchester United won the European Cup against Benfica in 1968, Jimmy ended nine years as an understudy to United's Alex Stepney to move to Highbury after impressing during a loan spell at Swansea.

Bertie Mee snapped up the shot-stopper in April 1974 for £40,000 and gave him his first-team debut against Liverpool shortly afterwards. Wilson announced his retirement at the end of that campaign and Rimmer became first choice, missing just three matches over the next three seasons, and won our Player of the Year award in 1975 and earned an England cap a year later.

Terry Neill's arrival as manager saw Pat Jennings follow him from Tottenham and Rimmer was duly sold to Aston Villa. He fared well there too and was first choice for six seasons, earning a First Division winners' medal in 1981 and helping Villa to glory in the 1982 European Cup and Super Cup. Rimmer later featured for Swansea City, Hamrum Spartans and Luton Town before retiring in 1986.
All our thoughts are with Jimmy's family and loved ones at this difficult time.

items.summaryZh: 俱乐部全体成员对前门将吉米·里默的逝世深感悲痛，他在70年代中期为我们出战146场。
bodyZh: 俱乐部全体成员对前门将吉米·里默的逝世深感悲痛。
吉米为我们出战146场，在接替传奇人物鲍勃·威尔逊成为一号门将后，于1975年荣膺年度最佳球员。
1968年曼联击败本菲卡赢得欧洲冠军杯时，吉米是未上场的替补，在斯旺西租借期间表现出色后，结束了九年作为亚历克斯·斯特普尼替补的生涯，转会至海布里。
1974年4月，伯蒂·米以4万英镑签下这位门将，并很快让他完成了对阵利物浦的一线队首秀。威尔逊在那个赛季末宣布退役，里默成为首选门将，在接下来的三个赛季中仅缺席三场比赛，1975年赢得年度最佳球员奖，一年后获得英格兰国家队出场机会。
特里·尼尔出任主教练后，帕特·詹宁斯从热刺追随而来，里默随即被出售至阿斯顿维拉。他在那里同样表现出色，连续六个赛季担任首选门将，1981年获得顶级联赛冠军奖牌，并帮助维拉在1982年赢得欧洲冠军杯和欧洲超级杯。里默后来效力于斯旺西城、哈姆伦斯巴达和卢顿，于1986年退役。
在这个艰难的时刻，我们的心与吉米的家人和爱人同在。

items.titleEn: Hotels.com and Arsenal renew multi-year partnership
items.summaryEn: The partnership continues as data shows a growing demand from travellers to turn sporting passions into memorable trips
bodyEn: Hotels.com have extended their global partnership with us, continuing a relationship that has connected supporters with travel experiences since 2023.

The multi-year agreement will see Hotels.com continue its role as an Official Partner, as demand for football-led travel continues to grow with more supporters travelling to experience the teams, players and competitions they care about most.

The renewed agreement will see Hotels.com retain a strong presence across our men’s and women’s teams and platforms. This includes prominent matchday visibility at Emirates Stadium, access to players, and rights to create content and campaigns that engage supporters around the world.
As Premier League champions, our influence extends far beyond matchday, offering Hotels.com a culturally relevant channel, with reach across key strategic travel markets for the brand.

Hotels.com has seen growing demand from travellers looking to turn their sporting passions into memorable trips. Data from Hotels.com revealed that during the Champions League final weekend, searches for stays in Budapest increased by 1,300%*, compared with the same period the previous year. The final two months of the Premier League season also saw travel searches for north London spike 30%** on matchdays.

With millions of supporters around the world, our global supporter base provides a powerful opportunity to inspire travel and reach communities across different countries, providing them access to curated travel packages and helping them support their team across the country and in Europe.
Over the coming seasons, Hotels.com will collaborate with us on campaigns and content designed to bring supporters closer to the club and inspire their next journey.
The renewal reflects a shared commitment to creating experiences that connect supporters with the moments, places and communities that make football special.

Natalie Wills, Senior Vice President of Integrated Marketing and Creative at Hotels.com, said: "There’s no question football has a unique power to unite supporters in a shared passion they'll cross borders for. As more travellers plan trips around meaningful experiences, we’re investing in partnerships that allow Hotels.com to show up in those moments of inspiration and intent.

“We’ve seen this partnership work. Arsenal gives us cultural resonance, access to the kind of globally engaged traveller we want to reach, and football is an important way for Hotels.com to connect passion with travel. We’re excited to extend our relationship and continue the partnership we’ve created together.”

Omar Shaikh, Global Partnerships & Ventures Director at Arsenal, added: “We’re delighted to continue our partnership with Hotels.com at such an exciting time for the club. Our supporters are at the heart of everything we do, and our partnership has helped create new ways for our global community to connect with us and share in some of our most memorable moments.

"We're ambitious about building on those foundations, winning more together, growing this incredible community and deepening the connection our supporters feel with our club wherever they are in the world. Our partners play an important role in those ambitions, and Hotels.com shares our passion for bringing our communities even closer to us. We're excited for the memories and experiences we will continue to create together in the years ahead."

Our partnership has already proven highly effective in elevating Hotels.com's brand presence among supporters worldwide. The collaboration has driven notable increases in awareness and consideration, while delivering exceptional global exposure and strong media value across the season.

items.titleZh: Hotels.com与阿森纳续签多年合作伙伴关系
items.summaryZh: 数据表明球迷旅游需求增长，双方继续合作。
bodyZh: Hotels.com已延长与我们达成的全球合作伙伴关系，延续自2023年以来将支持者与旅行体验连接起来的合作。
这项多年期协议将使Hotels.com继续担任官方合作伙伴，因为以足球为主的旅行需求持续增长，越来越多的支持者出行去体验他们最关心的球队、球员和赛事。
续签协议后，Hotels.com将继续在男女足球队和平台中保持强大的存在感，包括在酋长球场的显著比赛日曝光、球员接触权，以及制作内容和活动以吸引全球支持者的权利。
作为英超冠军，我们的影响力远远超出比赛日，为Hotels.com提供了一个具有文化相关性的渠道，覆盖该品牌的关键战略旅游市场。
Hotels.com发现，希望将体育热情转化为难忘旅程的旅行者需求不断增长。其数据显示，在欧冠决赛周末，布达佩斯住宿搜索量同比增长了1300%*。英超赛季最后两个月的比赛日，伦敦北部的旅行搜索量也飙升了30%**。
我们拥有全球数百万支持者，这为激发旅行热情、触达不同国家社区提供了强大机会，让他们获得精心策划的旅行套餐，并帮助他们在英国和欧洲支持自己的球队。
在接下来的几个赛季中，Hotels.com将与我们合作开展活动和内容，旨在拉近支持者与俱乐部的距离，并激发他们的下一次旅程。
此次续约体现了双方的共同承诺，即创造将支持者与足球独特时刻、地点和社区联系起来的体验。
Hotels.com综合营销与创意高级副总裁Natalie Wills表示：“毫无疑问，足球具有独特的力量，能让支持者团结在一种他们愿意跨越国界的共同热情中。随着越来越多的旅行者围绕有意义的体验规划行程，我们正在投资合作伙伴关系，让Hotels.com出现在这些灵感和意图的时刻。”
“我们已经看到了这种合作关系的成效。阿森纳给了我们文化共鸣，让我们触达想要接触的全球参与型旅行者，而足球是Hotels.com将热情与旅行连接的重要方式。我们很高兴延长合作关系，继续我们共同建立的伙伴关系。”
阿森纳全球合作伙伴与风险投资总监Omar Shaikh补充道：“我们很高兴在俱乐部如此激动人心的时刻继续与Hotels.com的合作。支持者是我们一切工作的核心，我们的合作帮助创造了新方式，让全球社区与我们连接，分享我们最难忘的时刻。”
“我们志向远大，要在这些基础上再接再厉，共同赢得更多胜利，发展这个令人难以置信的社区，并加深支持者无论身在何处对俱乐部的情感联系。我们的合作伙伴在这些抱负中扮演着重要角色，Hotels.com与我们一样热衷于让社区更接近我们。我们期待未来共同创造更多美好回忆和体验。”
我们的合作已被证明在提升Hotels.com全球支持者中的品牌知名度方面非常有效。该合作显著提升了认知度和考虑度，同时在整个赛季中带来了卓越的全球曝光和强大的媒体价值。
*数据基于Hotels.com英国网站2026年5月6日至30日期间对2026年5月29日或30日布达佩斯住宿的搜索，与2025年同期比较。**数据基于Hotels.com英国网站2026年4月1日至5月18日期间仅比赛日入住的搜索，与2025年同期比较。

items.summaryEn: We closed out our pre-season camp in Spain with a narrow defeat to Milan
bodyEn: We concluded our women's pre-season camp in La Manga with a friendly against AC Milan.
Despite goals from Leah Williamson and Selina Cerci, the Italian side came away 3-2 winners in scorching conditions.
First Half
Our first chance of the match came courtesy of Georgia Stanway, who plucked a stray clearance from the air and drove at goal, laying off to Olivia Smith.
There was great link up play once again between Stanway and Smith, with a chance nearly falling to Lisa Baum in the box, only for the AC Milan goalkeeper to pounce just in time.
Against the run of play, Thea Kyvag put the Italian side ahead of 25 minutes, capitalising on some confusion at the back.
In search of an equaliser, Alessia Russo and Stina Blackstenius both hit the crossbar from aerial efforts, while Kim Little had a volley smothered by the keeper.
Second Half

We increased the intensity in the second half and it didn’t take long for us to draw level through a set piece. Smith delivered a powerful corner to the front post and Leah Williamson rose high to head home.

Smith came close to adding her own name to the scoresheet 10 minutes later - dancing through the defence before being brought down outside the box. Academy prospects Kyri Teer-Hutchins, Amelia Marriott, Abi Conway and Bella Cowley all made valuable contributions across the pitch, pairing well with established members of the squad.

On another breakaway, Sara Stokic put Milan back ahead after 70 minutes, curling a powerful strike past Isabella Damm. A few minutes later, Damm made a great double save to stop Stokic getting a second, before we looked to turn our dominant possession into an equaliser.

Chloe Kelly’s deep corner found Selina Cerci, whose bullet header was denied by the crossbar once more. But Cerci wouldn’t have to wait long to bag her first goal in Arsenal colours, thanks to a superbly taken strike outside the area.
The twists weren’t over though, AC Milan capitalised from the restart, and immediately regained the lead through Monica Renzotti, seconds from time.
What's next

Before our Women's Super League campaign gets underway with a trip to Brighton & Hove Albion, we'll host Paris FC (August 23) and Charlton Athletic (August 26) in friendlies at Mangata Developments Stadium.
Tickets for both games are available here.

items.summaryZh: 女足在西班牙季前训练营收官战中惜败米兰。
bodyZh: 我们在西班牙拉曼加的训练营以一场对阵AC米兰的友谊赛收官。
尽管利亚·威廉森和塞琳娜·切尔奇取得进球，但意大利球队在炎热的条件下以3-2获胜。
上半场
我们本场比赛的首次机会来自乔治亚·斯坦威，她截下对方解围球后带球推进，将球分给奥利维亚·史密斯。
斯坦威和史密斯之间再次展现出精彩的配合，丽莎·鲍姆在禁区内险些获得机会，可惜AC米兰门将及时出击。
尽管局势不占优，西娅·基瓦格在第25分钟利用后场混乱，为意大利球队取得领先。
为了寻找扳平机会，阿莱西娅·鲁索和斯蒂娜·布莱克斯坦纽斯都有头球击中横梁，而金·利特尔的一记凌空抽射被门将扑出。
下半场
下半场我们提高了强度，并很快通过一次定位球扳平比分。史密斯开出强力角球到前点，利亚·威廉森高高跃起头球破门。
10分钟后，史密斯险些亲自进球——她在过人后于禁区外被放倒。青训学院的基里·蒂尔-哈钦斯、阿米莉亚·马里奥特、阿比·康威和贝拉·考利在场上都做出了宝贵贡献，与队中资深球员配合默契。
另一次反击中，萨拉·斯托基奇在第70分钟为米兰再次取得领先，她的一记强力弧线球越过伊莎贝拉·达姆。几分钟后，达姆做出精彩的两连扑，阻止斯托基奇梅开二度，随后我们试图将控球优势转化为扳平进球。
克洛伊·凯利开出的深角球找到塞琳娜·切尔奇，她的强力头球再次被横梁拒绝。但切尔奇等待在阿森纳的处子球没多久，她以一记精彩的禁区外射门完成破门。
但剧情并未结束，AC米兰利用重新开球的机会，在比赛最后时刻通过莫妮卡·伦佐蒂迅速重新取得领先。
接下来的赛程
在女超联赛揭幕战客场对阵布莱顿霍夫阿尔比恩之前，我们将在曼加塔发展体育场与巴黎FC（8月23日）和查尔顿竞技（8月26日）进行友谊赛。
两场比赛的门票均可在此购买。

items.titleEn: Arsenal in the Community celebrates outstanding post-16 results
items.summaryEn: Arsenal in the Community celebrates post-16 results
bodyEn: Arsenal in the Community is celebrating another fantastic set of post-16 results, with students achieving excellent grades across our Level 2 and Level 3 provision.

The results are a testament to the hard work, commitment and determination shown by our students throughout the year, alongside the support and dedication of our staff. All of our Sport Study Programmes are supported by United Colleges Group.
Nine students studying the Level 2 NCFE Diploma in Sport achieved an impressive set of results, with four students achieving a Distinction*, four achieving a Distinction and one achieving a Merit.

Seven of the nine learners will continue their education with Arsenal in the Community, progressing onto our Level 3 Diploma and Extended Diploma in Sport courses in September. One student will continue their studies on a Level 3 course at another college, while another will begin an apprenticeship.
Our Level 3 NCFE Diploma in Sport and Physical Activity students also achieved fantastic results, with both students achieving a Distinction* and progressing into employment.

There was further success for our Level 3 Extended Diploma in Sport and Physical Activity cohort, with all 14 (100%) students achieving a Distinction* or Distinction. Eleven students achieved a Distinction*, while three achieved a Distinction.
Following their results, five students will progress to full-time degree courses at university, seven will move directly into employment and two have secured sport-based apprenticeships.
Behind the impressive results are a number of individual stories that highlight the different pathways available to students through Arsenal in the Community.

Whether progressing to university, entering employment or taking on an apprenticeship, our students are using the knowledge, experience and confidence gained through their studies to take exciting next steps towards their future careers.
Hope Parsons: combining education, coaching and career opportunities
Hope completed the Level 3 Extended Diploma in Sport and Physical Activity with a Distinction*.
During her time with Arsenal in the Community, Hope completed the Powerhouse Project UEFA B Prep programme, further developing her coaching knowledge and experience alongside her studies.

Her hard work has helped open several exciting opportunities. Hope has successfully been accepted onto the UEFA B coaching course and has secured a coaching role with a BWSL club for the upcoming season.
Alongside her coaching career, Hope will continue her academic journey at Staffordshire University, where she will study for a BSc in Psychology of Sport and Exercise.
Alisha: progressing from Level 2 to an apprenticeship
Alisha is another fantastic example of progression through Arsenal in the Community's post-16 pathway.

Having originally joined the Level 2 course in September 2023, Alisha continued her development by progressing onto the Level 3 Extended Diploma in Sport and Physical Activity, where she achieved an impressive Distinction*.
Her progression has continued beyond her studies, with Alisha securing a Sport and PE Curriculum Apprenticeship, which she will begin in September.
Luca: taking his next step at Durham University
Luca also achieved an outstanding result on the Level 3 Extended Diploma in Sport and Physical Activity, earning a Distinction*.
He will now take the next step in his academic journey, having secured a place at Durham University, where he will study Sport and Exercise Science.
Jess: building towards a career in physiotherapy
Jess has enjoyed a fantastic year on the Level 2 NCFE Diploma in Sport, achieving a Distinction*.

Jess will continue her studies with Arsenal in the Community in September, progressing onto our Level 3 Diploma in Sport and Physical Activity as she continues to pursue her ambition of becoming a physiotherapist.
Alongside her excellent vocational result, Jess also demonstrated her determination to succeed academically, achieving a Grade 4 in GCSE English during the November resits.
Nathan and Taylan: taking their future into their own hands
Nathan and Taylan are celebrating after both achieving a Distinction* on the Level 3 Extended Diploma in Sport and Physical Activity.
The pair are already taking their future into their own hands, having come together to launch their own coaching company, Phase One Coaching, specifically working with U7-U9 players.
Both Nathan and Taylan are aiming to build careers in coaching, with the UEFA B Coaching Badge their next goal as they continue to develop their qualifications and experience.

Holly Walker, Sports Study Programme Teacher, said: “We’re incredibly proud of our 2026 graduates and everything they have achieved. Results Day is always a really rewarding time because you get to see all the hard work, commitment and challenges that the students have faced throughout the year come together. To see so many of them achieve such fantastic grades is a brilliant feeling, but what makes us even prouder is seeing where they are going next.

“Whether that’s progressing to university, starting an apprenticeship, going into employment or continuing their studies with us, every student has their own journey and their own ambitions. We’ve seen them grow in confidence, develop their skills and become much more independent during their time with us.

“As teachers, that’s one of the most rewarding parts of the role - knowing that we’ve played a small part in helping them take the next step towards their future. They should all be extremely proud of themselves and what they’ve achieved.”
Freddie Hudson, Director of Arsenal in the Community, added:

"It’s great to see another strong year of results for our NCFE students. Their hard work and commitment are reflected in these excellent grades, and we are incredibly proud of every one of them. Huge congratulations and well done to all our students.

"Behind these achievements is a dedicated team of Arsenal in the Community teachers, tutors and wider staff who make it all possible. They create an environment of belonging and aspiration, while supporting each student with great care beyond the classroom. I would like to thank them for all they do and the passion and pride they bring to their work every day.

"We recognise the important role we play at such a significant stage in the lives of young people, extending far beyond qualifications, and we deliver this in a uniquely Arsenal way. As we approach the new academic year, we wish the very best of luck to the students moving on to their next chapter, warmly welcome those joining us, and look forward to supporting those continuing their education journey with us."

"The results and destinations achieved by this year’s cohort highlight the commitment and determination of our post-16 students. From outstanding academic results to progressing to university, employment and apprenticeships, the cohort has demonstrated the impact of their hard work throughout their time with Arsenal in the Community."
We are incredibly proud of all our post-16 graduates.
Congratulations to everyone receiving their results, and best of luck as they take the next steps in their education, employment and careers.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳社区庆祝16岁后教育成果斐然
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳社区庆祝16岁后教育佳绩
bodyZh: 阿森纳社区正在庆祝又一批出色的16岁后教育成果，学生们的二级和三级课程均取得了优异成绩。
这些成绩证明了学生们在一年中的刻苦努力、投入和决心，以及我们工作人员的支持和奉献。我们所有的体育学习项目都得到了联合学院集团的支持。
九名学习二级NCFE体育文凭的学生取得了令人瞩目的成绩，其中四人获得Distinction*，四人获得Distinction，一人获得Merit。
九名学习者中有七人将继续在阿森纳社区深造，于九月升读我们的三级体育文凭和扩展文凭课程。一名学生将在另一所学院继续学习三级课程，另一名学生将开始学徒。
我们的三级NCFE体育与体育活动文凭学生同样成绩斐然，两名学生均获得Distinction*，并进入就业。
三级体育与体育活动扩展文凭班也取得了更大成功，全部14名（100%）学生均获得Distinction*或Distinction。其中11人获得Distinction*，3人获得Distinction。
获得成绩后，五名学生将升入大学攻读全日制学位课程，七人将直接就业，两人已获得体育类学徒机会。
在这些令人瞩目的成绩背后，是许多个人故事，凸显了阿森纳社区为学生提供的不同发展路径。
无论是升入大学、进入职场还是开始学徒，我们的学生都在运用通过学业获得的知识、经验和信心，向未来职业生涯迈出激动人心的下一步。
Hope Parsons：结合教育、执教与职业机会
Hope以Distinction*成绩完成了三级体育与体育活动扩展文凭。
在阿森纳社区期间，Hope完成了Powerhouse项目欧足联B级预备课程，在学业之外进一步提升了执教知识和经验。
她的努力为她打开了多个令人兴奋的机会。Hope成功获得欧足联B级教练课程的录取，并获得了新赛季在BWSL俱乐部担任教练的职位。
在执教的同时，Hope将继续在斯塔福德郡大学的学术之旅，攻读体育与运动心理学理学士学位。
Alisha：从二级课程升至学徒
Alisha是阿森纳社区16岁后发展路径的又一个绝佳例证。
Alisha最初于2023年9月加入二级课程，随后通过升读三级体育与体育活动扩展文凭继续发展，并取得了令人瞩目的Distinction*成绩。
她的发展并未止步于学业，Alisha已获得体育与体育课程学徒职位，并将在九月开始。
Luca：在杜伦大学迈出下一步
Luca同样在三级体育与体育活动扩展文凭中取得了优异成绩，获得Distinction*。
他现已获得杜伦大学的录取资格，将迈出学术生涯的下一步，攻读体育与运动科学。
Jess：向物理治疗职业生涯迈进
Jess在二级NCFE体育文凭课程中度过了精彩的一年，取得了Distinction*。
Jess将于九月继续在阿森纳社区学习，升读我们的三级体育与体育活动文凭，继续追求她成为物理治疗师的抱负。
除了优异的职业资格成绩外，Jess还展现了在学业上取得成功的决心，在十一月补考中英语GCSE考试中获得了4级成绩。
Nathan和Taylan：将未来掌握在自己手中
Nathan和Taylan在三级体育与体育活动扩展文凭中双双获得Distinction*，正在庆祝。
两人已经开始掌控自己的未来，他们共同创办了自己的教练公司Phase One Coaching，专门面向U7-U9年龄段的球员。
Nathan和Taylan都立志在教练领域发展职业生涯，他们正在继续提升自己的资格和经验，下一个目标是获得欧足联B级教练徽章。
体育学习项目教师Holly Walker表示：“我们为2026届毕业生及其所取得的一切成就感到无比自豪。放榜日总是一个收获颇丰的时刻，因为你会看到学生们全年付出的所有努力、投入和挑战汇聚在一起。看到这么多人取得如此优异的成绩，感觉非常棒，但更让我们自豪的是看到他们将前往何方。”
“无论是升入大学、开始学徒、进入职场还是继续与我们学习，每个学生都有自己的旅程和抱负。我们看到他们在我们这里期间增强了自信，发展了技能，并变得更加独立。”
“作为教师，这是这个角色最有收获的部分之一——知道我们为帮助他们迈向未来的下一步发挥了微小作用。他们都应该为自己以及自己取得的成就感到无比自豪。”
阿森纳社区总监Freddie Hudson补充道：
“看到我们的NCFE学生又一年取得优异成绩，真是太好了。他们的努力和投入体现在这些出色的成绩中，我们为每一位学生感到无比自豪。向所有学生表示热烈祝贺，干得漂亮。”
“这些成就的背后是阿森纳社区一支敬业的教师、导师和其他员工团队，是他们让这一切成为可能。他们营造了一种归属感和抱负感的环境，在课堂之外给予每位学生无微不至的支持。我要感谢他们所做的一切，以及他们每天工作中带来的热情和自豪感。”
“我们认识到自己在年轻人生命中如此重要的阶段所扮演的重要角色，这远远超出了资格证书的范畴，我们以独特的阿森纳方式传递这一切。随着新学年的临近，我们向即将开启新篇章的学生们致以最美好的祝愿，热烈欢迎加入我们的人，并期待支持那些继续与我们同行教育之旅的人。”
“本年度学生群体所取得的成绩和去向，突显了我们16岁后学生的投入与决心。从优异的学业成绩到升读大学、就业和学徒，这一群体展现了他们在阿森纳社区期间的刻苦努力所产生的影响。”
“我们为所有16岁后的毕业生感到无比骄傲。”
“祝贺所有收到成绩的人，并祝他们在教育、就业和职业生涯的下一步中好运。”

bodyEn: Curtis Jones’s future has been the subject of much gossipmongering this summer, especially with Inter plonking him in the middle of their radar. The Italian club have sniffed around the midfielder for quite a while and may ramp up their interest very soon with a bid of £30m to test Liverpool’s resolve.

Ipswich are not willing to stop their summer spending and a return for Julio Enciso looks nailed on. The Paraguay international had an injury-plagued loan spell at Portman Road in 2025 but is back to lead their battle for Premier League survival after a permanent deal was agreed with Strasbourg. Also making the move from the French club is right-back Abdoul Ouattara.

Crystal Palace have been knocked back by Monaco with a £35m bid for midfielder Lamine Camara. The Ligue 1 club are not particularly keen to sell him after getting a decent whack for Aladji Bamba, ensuring their finances are very healthy.

It may be the case that Arsenal need to sell a few players on, as is the case with Myles Lewis-Skelly. Another available player is Gabriel Martinelli who is attracting interest from Galatasaray. The Turkish giants are willing to splash a whopping £38m on the Brazilian. Gala are taking a keen look at Premier League players, with Liverpool’s Alexis Mac Allister another wanted.

After completing a deal for Lucas Herrington, Hull will bring in Joe Gelhardt from Leeds. The forward spent time on loan with the Tigers, helping them get promoted to the Premier League. Another inquiry has been made to Juventus over the availability of Teun Koopmeiners.

Aston Villa are priming themselves for a busy end to the window. João Palhinha has agreed to join on loan but Bayern Munich are eager to sell him. Jonathan David may also turn up in the West Midlands after the Villans got on the blower to Juventus.

Aaron Wan-Bissaka may not fancy a season in the second tier with West Ham. Thankfully for the DR Congo full-back Aston Villa and Fulham are both in for him at the moment, but Villa Park is the more likely destination. On the other side of the Hammers defence is El Hadji Malick Diouf. Sunderland have put a figure on him with a £40m bid but that is not enough for him to be allowed to head up to the Stadium of Light because his employers want £10m more.

Kyle Walker was a target for David Moyes a year ago and the Scot could offer him a route out of Burnley to Everton. The former England right-back has a year remaining on his contract but may fancy a season on Merseyside.

items.titleZh: 足球转会传闻：加拉塔萨雷豪掷3800万英镑求购阿森纳的马丁内利？
items.summaryZh: 今日传闻偏爱邦妮·泰勒版本， Curtis Jones 的未来成焦点。
bodyZh: 柯蒂斯·琼斯的未来今夏成为众多流言的主题，尤其是国际米兰将他列入重点引援目标。这家意大利俱乐部对这位中场球员觊觎已久，可能很快就会以3000万英镑的报价试探利物浦的决心，从而加大兴趣。
伊普斯维奇不愿停止今夏的引援步伐，胡利奥·恩西索的回归看似板上钉钉。这位巴拉圭国脚2025年在波特曼路球场的租借期饱受伤病困扰，但在与斯特拉斯堡达成永久转会后，他将回归带领球队为英超保级而战。同样从这家法国俱乐部加盟的还有右后卫阿卜杜勒·瓦塔拉。
水晶宫以3500万英镑报价摩纳哥中场拉明·卡马拉，但遭到拒绝。这家法甲俱乐部在出售阿莱吉·班巴后获得可观收入，财政状况良好，因此并不特别急于将他出售。
阿森纳可能需要出售一些球员，比如迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利。另一位可出售的球员是加布里埃尔·马丁内利，他引起了加拉塔萨雷的兴趣。这家土耳其豪门愿意为这位巴西人豪掷3800万英镑。加拉塔萨雷正在密切关注英超球员，利物浦的亚历克西斯·麦卡利斯特也是目标之一。
在完成卢卡斯·赫林顿的交易后，赫尔城将从利兹联引进乔·格尔哈特。这位前锋曾租借效力于老虎队，帮助球队升入英超。此外，他们还就特恩·科普梅纳斯的可用性向尤文图斯进行了询问。
阿斯顿维拉正为转会窗结束前的忙碌做准备。若昂·帕利尼亚已同意租借加盟，但拜仁慕尼黑渴望将他出售。乔纳森·戴维也可能出现在西米德兰兹，因为维拉已经联系了尤文图斯。
阿隆·万-比萨卡可能不愿随西汉姆联征战英冠赛季。对这位刚果民主共和国边后卫来说，幸运的是阿斯顿维拉和富勒姆目前都在追求他，但维拉公园是更可能的目的地。西汉姆防线另一侧的目标是埃尔·哈吉·马利克·迪乌夫。桑德兰已报价4000万英镑求购他，但这不足以让他加盟光明球场，因为其东家想要再多1000万英镑。
凯尔·沃克一年前曾是戴维·莫耶斯的目标，这位苏格兰教练可能为他提供离开伯恩利转投埃弗顿的出路。这位前英格兰右后卫的合同还剩一年，但他可能愿意在默西塞德度过一个赛季。

bodyEn: Myles Lewis-Skelly has been offered to Manchester United as a potential left-back option, with Arsenal wishing to recoup some of the £75m paid to Newcastle for Bruno Guimarães.

Chelsea, it is understood, have also been made aware of the 19-year-old’s availability. Lewis-Skelly won the Premier League under Mikel Arteta last term, but whether the west London club will make a move for him is unclear.

Lewis-Skelly, who made only five league starts and 36 appearances in all competitions in 2025-26, signed a five-year contract last summer. His prospective price is thought to be in the region of £45m.

This is within the range of finance United have spent so far this summer, after Youri Tielemans’s £35m move from Aston Villa and Andrey Santos’s arrival for £48m plus £2m of add-ons from Chelsea. United are now weighing up a move for the teenager.

Newcastle’s Lewis Hall remains of prime interest for United but, after losing Guimarães, Sandro Tonali to Tottenham, and Anthony Gordon to Barcelona, the new Newcastle manager, Matthias Jaissle, is intent the 21-year-old England international does not also depart
RB Leipzig’s 28-year-old left-back David Raum is another in the position United may assess.

Chelsea have already had a busy summer in the market, having spent over £300m on a raft of new signings. Maxence Lacroix and Marco Palestra have been brought in to bolster the centre and right of the defence respectively, while Morgan Rogers became the club’s record signing at a cost of £117m.

But Xabi Alonso’s side have a hole on the left of their defence after Marc Cucurella’s £52m move to Real Madrid. The 20-year-old Jorrel Hato, who featured for the Netherlands at the World Cup, was Cucurella’s deputy at left-back.
Mason Mount missed training on Monday and Tuesday at United’s County Kildare summer training camp owing to a knock he received on a foot in Saturday’s 1-1 draw with Paris Saint-Germain in Gothenburg.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳小将刘易斯-斯凯利被推荐给曼联补强左后卫
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳将刘易斯-斯凯利推荐给曼联，切尔西也已得知球员可售；纽卡后卫霍尔仍是曼联首选。
bodyZh: 迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利已被推荐给曼联，作为左后卫的潜在人选，阿森纳希望收回支付给纽卡斯尔引进布鲁诺·吉马良斯的部分7500万英镑费用。
据了解，切尔西也已得知这位19岁小将可以转会。刘易斯-斯凯利上赛季在米克尔·阿尔特塔麾下赢得了英超冠军，但这支西伦敦球队是否会求购他尚不清楚。
刘易斯-斯凯利在2025-26赛季仅获得5次联赛首发，各项赛事出场36次，去年夏天签下了一份五年合同。他的预计转会费在4500万英镑左右。
这一价格在曼联今夏迄今为止的投入范围内，此前曼联以3500万英镑签下尤里·蒂莱曼斯，并以4800万英镑加200万英镑附加条款从切尔西引进安德烈·桑托斯。曼联目前正在考虑求购这位小将。
纽卡斯尔的刘易斯·霍尔仍是曼联的首要目标，但在失去吉马良斯、桑德罗·托纳利（转会热刺）和安东尼·戈登（转会巴萨）后，纽卡新帅马蒂亚斯·雅伊斯勒决心不让这位21岁的英格兰国脚也离开。
RB莱比锡的28岁左后卫大卫·劳姆是曼联可能评估的另一个目标。
切尔西在转会市场上已经度过了一个繁忙的夏天，已花费超过3亿英镑签下多名新援。马克桑斯·拉克鲁瓦和马可·帕莱斯特拉分别被引进以加强中卫和右后卫位置，而摩根·罗杰斯以1.17亿英镑成为俱乐部历史标王。
但在马克·库库雷利亚以5200万英镑转会皇马后，哈维·阿隆索的球队在左后卫位置出现空缺。20岁的约雷尔·哈托曾在世界杯上代表荷兰队出场，是库库雷利亚在左后卫位置上的替补。
梅森·芒特因在周六哥德堡1-1战平巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛中脚部受伤，缺席了曼联在基尔代尔郡夏季训练营周一和周二的训练。

bodyEn: Arsenal are stepping up their efforts to sign defensive cover for William Saliba after Mikel Arteta revealed that Jurriën Timber is well away from returning to competitive action. Saliba will be out for an extended period after breaking down during the World Cup with a back injury.

After Arsenal lost a second successive friendly when Borussia Dortmund won 3-2 on Sunday to lift the Emirates Cup in a performance that featured several defensive mistakes, Arteta would not be drawn on when the France defender is expected to return, but said it would take “some time to heal”.

There are also concerns over Timber, who pulled out of the Netherlands squad on the eve of the World Cup after failing to recover from a persistent groin injury that forced him to miss most of the run‑in last season.
“Jurriën is progressing really well,” Arteta said. “He’s on the pitch, he’s doing quite a lot right now, but it’s still weeks away. I cannot tell you how much.
“William Saliba is in rest mode at the moment for two weeks. He had to do almost nothing, an aggravated injury, so it’s going to take some time to heal.”

Pressed on how Arsenal will cope without Saliba, he said: “We have experienced that in the past, unfortunately. When he’s been available, he’s hit home and the stats are incredible. We know we lost a massive player, the same with Jurriën.”

Arsenal have had a bid for Aston Villa’s Ezri Konsa rejected and are expected to return with a new offer for the England centre-back, who is also capable of playing at right-back. Villa value him at £60m, but with less than two years left on his contract Arsenal are unwilling to pay that much for the 28‑year‑old.

The Premier League champions have also shown an interest in signing Cristian Romero from Tottenham, but any move for the Argentina defender is extremely unlikely given Spurs’ reluctance to sell to their north London rivals.

Arteta, who started against Dortmund with Cristhian Mosquera in central defence alongside Gabriel Magalhães, said Arsenal’s existing players must get up to speed before the Community Shield against Manchester City on Sunday, but did not rule out bringing in another defender.

“It has to be the right player in the market to make us much better,” he said. “We conceded some poor goals today, in the way we competed especially. But that’s a collective responsibility. So we need to improve with the players we have.”

items.titleZh: 阿森纳加快补强防线，廷贝尔与萨利巴缺阵
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳加速补强防线，预计再报价孔萨；阿尔特塔称现有球员需提升，廷贝尔远未复出，萨利巴伤停。
bodyZh: 在米克尔·阿尔特塔透露尤里恩·廷贝尔距离复出参赛还很遥远之后，阿森纳正在加大力度为威廉·萨利巴引进防守替补。萨利巴在世界杯期间背部受伤，将长时间缺阵。
周日，阿森纳在一场友谊赛中再次失利，多特蒙德以3-2获胜并捧起酋长杯，比赛中阿森纳出现多次防守失误。阿尔特塔不愿透露这位法国后卫预计何时回归，但表示需要“一段时间来恢复”。
廷贝尔也令人担忧，他在世界杯前夕因未能从持续的腹股沟伤势中恢复而退出荷兰队，这一伤势使他缺席了上赛季大部分尾声比赛。
“尤里恩恢复得非常好，”阿尔特塔说。“他已经在球场上了，目前做很多事情，但还差几个星期。我不能告诉你具体多久。”
“威廉·萨利巴目前处于休息状态，为期两周。他几乎不能做任何事，因为伤势加重，所以需要一些时间恢复。”
当被问及阿森纳如何在缺少萨利巴的情况下应对时，他说：“不幸的是，我们过去也经历过这种情况。当他可以上场时，他的表现非常出色，数据令人难以置信。我们知道我们失去了一名重要球员，廷贝尔也是如此。”
阿森纳对阿斯顿维拉的埃兹里·孔萨提出的报价已被拒绝，预计他们将向这位英格兰中卫提出新的报价，孔萨也能胜任右后卫。维拉对他的估价为6000万英镑，但鉴于其合同剩余不到两年，阿森纳不愿为这位28岁的球员支付如此高的价格。
英超冠军也对从托特纳姆热刺签下克里斯蒂安·罗梅罗表现出兴趣，但鉴于热刺不愿出售给北伦敦对手，任何引进这位阿根廷后卫的举动都极不可能。

items.summaryEn: With most of their rivals changing managers, can the champions go back-to-back for the first time in more than 90 years?Guardian writers’ predicted position: 1st (NB: this is not necessarily Ed Aarons’ prediction but the average of our writers’ tips)Last season’s position: 1st Continue reading...
bodyEn: Guardian writers’ predicted position: 1st (NB: this is not necessarily Ed Aarons’ prediction but the average of our writers’ tips)
Last season’s position: 1st

Even losing on penalties in the Champions League final could not take any of the gloss off last season as Arsenal ended their 22-year wait to be crowned Premier League champions. The celebrations have continued all summer after some wild scenes on the streets of north London on their return from Budapest, although concerns over the fitness of some key players after their exploits at the World Cup are mounting.

Arsenal have acted quickly to reinforce their midfield by signing Bruno Guimarães from Newcastle given Declan Rice’s workload must be managed very carefully after playing through neural pain in his hamstring and lower back since December. The arrival of Greece forward Christos Tzolis to replace Leandro Trossard also looks like a smart piece of business on the left-hand side of the attack. But with Vinícius Junior staying at Real Madrid, despite Arsenal’s best efforts, supporters will be hoping there is still a chance that the sporting director, Andrea Berta, could conjure up a heavyweight attacking signing before the window closes given Bukayo Saka’s fitness problems in recent seasons.

The back injury that will sideline William Saliba for an unknown period could prove even more central to Arsenal’s hopes of retaining their title. A defence that conceded 27 goals last year in the Premier League may struggle without the immense talents of the France defender, even if they can bring in Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa as hoped. Whether Arsenal can maintain their dominance from set pieces over the past two campaigns will also be crucial, with more scrutiny expected from video assistant referees after the fallout from their controversial victory at West Ham in May.

Not since 1935, when Arsenal became the second team to win three successive league titles, have they retained their crown. Having strengthened the deepest squad in the division still further, they will take some stopping again.

Money definitely isn’t an issue for Stan Kroenke. Arsenal’s co-owner became America’s largest private landowner this year and has spent more than £1.5bn on new players since becoming the majority shareholder in 2011 through his holding company, Kroenke Sports & Entertainment (KSE). Next on the agenda is an upgrade to the Emirates Stadium that could increase the capacity of their home to more than 70,000. Talks have begun with the stadium’s original architects, Populous, over a project that could cost up to £500m. The much-criticised shirtsleeve deal with Visit Rwanda ended last season and has been replaced by the HR company Deel, itself controversial in some sections of the Arsenal fanbase, while Emirates have renewed their longstanding partnership until 2033.

Kroenke and his son Josh – who are co-chairs – clearly revelled in carrying out the Premier League trophy at Selhurst Park before it was presented to the captain, Martin Ødegaard, after Arsenal’s final game of the season in May. Having once been criticised for running the club “like an investment vehicle”, now they are praised for the enormous effect they have made. Kroenke Jr’s promise there would be “no standing still once this season ends” was an ominous sign to their rivals given KSE have a reputation as serial winners in a number of sports in America.

Mikel Arteta’s expected bumper new contract extension – that will make him one of the best-paid managers in the world – has yet to be confirmed, but there is no doubting his commitment to the cause. The Spaniard could not bear to watch as Manchester City’s challenge collapsed against Bournemouth last season and was in his back garden “building a fire” when Arsenal were confirmed as champions. With Pep Guardiola gone, Arteta has the opportunity to build a new winning dynasty of his own.

The arrival of Guimarães was another big statement of intent from Arsenal. The former Newcastle captain wants to win more trophies after capturing hearts and minds on Tyneside and he will provide several options in the already well-stacked engine room. As well as relieving the load on Rice, the versatile 28-year-old Brazil midfielder is capable of fulfilling a number of roles, from deep-lying playmaker to box-to box destroyer. While it remains to be seen how Arteta chooses to use Guimarães when he also has Martín Zubimendi, Myles Lewis-Skelly, Ødegaard and Mikel Merino at his disposal, his talents will only add to the quality in Arsenal’s squad.

Referees have been told to pay much more attention to grappling during set-pieces this season so it will be interesting to see if this has any effect on Arsenal. Only three teams in the Premier League had a better non-penalty expected goal difference than the Gunners had from set plays alone.

Max Dowman was a record-breaking revelation as he dipped his toes into senior football for the first time last season and the signs are that the 16-year-old could be handed more opportunities after impressing again during pre-season. A brilliant goal and an assist against Girona capped a man-of-the-match display from the right flank. With Saka and Noni Madueke to be eased back in after returning from World Cup duty, Dowman is ready to add to his solitary Premier League start, against Crystal Palace on the final day of last season, and should appear more regularly in cup competitions.

Rice and Saka arrived in the United States feeling the effects of a marathon season and it was to their immense credit that they played through the pain barrier and made it to England’s eighth match of the tournament. Only Thomas Tuchel knows why he left Saka on the bench in the semi-final against Argentina and his hat-trick in the third-place playoff a few days later showed how potent he can be even with an achilles problem. Both require an extended break before returning to the rigours of club football and Arsenal will give them as long as possible. But such is their importance that it will be sooner rather than later.

items.titleZh: 英超2026-27赛季前瞻（一）：阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 大多数对手换帅，阿森纳能否成为1935年以来首支卫冕英超的球队？《卫报》记者预测首位。
bodyZh: 《卫报》记者预测排名：第1位（注：这不一定是埃德·阿伦斯的预测，而是我们记者建议的平均值）
上赛季排名：第1位
尽管在欧冠决赛中点球失利，但这并未给上赛季的阿森纳蒙上阴影，因为他们结束了22年的等待，加冕英超冠军。从布达佩斯归来后，北伦敦街头出现了狂野的庆祝场面，整个夏天庆祝活动持续不断，不过一些关键球员在世界杯上的征战后的身体状况令人担忧。

阿森纳迅速行动，从纽卡斯尔签下布鲁诺·吉马良斯以加强中场，因为德克兰·赖斯自12月以来一直带着腿筋和下背部的神经疼痛出战，他的负荷必须得到非常谨慎的管理。希腊前锋克里斯托斯·佐利斯的到来，以取代莱安德罗·特罗萨德，看起来也是进攻左路的一笔精明操作。但尽管阿森纳尽了最大努力，维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔仍留在皇家马德里，球迷们仍希望体育总监安德里亚·贝尔塔有机会在转会窗口关闭前变出一笔重量级攻击线签约，因为布卡约·萨卡近几个赛季都存在伤病问题。
威廉·萨利巴的背伤将使他缺席一段时间，具体时长未知，这可能对阿森纳卫冕的希望更为关键。上赛季英超联赛中丢球27个的防线，如果没有这位法国后卫的巨大才能，可能会陷入困境，即使他们能如愿从阿斯顿维拉引进埃兹里·孔萨。阿森纳能否保持过去两个赛季在定位球上的统治力也至关重要，在五月客场击败西汉姆联的争议胜利引发风波后，视频助理裁判预计将进行更多审查。
自1935年阿森纳成为第二支赢得三连冠的球队以来，他们还从未成功卫冕过。在进一步加强了联赛中最深厚的阵容后，他们再次势不可挡。

对于斯坦·克伦克来说，金钱绝对不是问题。阿森纳的联合所有者今年成为美国最大的私人土地所有者，自2011年通过其控股公司克伦克体育娱乐公司（KSE）成为大股东以来，他已在新球员身上花费超过15亿英镑。接下来的议程是升级酋长球场，可能将主场容量增加到7万人以上。已与球场的原始建筑师Populous就一项可能耗资高达5亿英镑的项目展开谈判。备受批评的与卢旺达旅游的衣袖赞助合同在上赛季结束，取而代之的是人力资源公司Deel，这本身在阿森纳部分球迷群体中就存在争议，而阿联酋航空已将长期合作续约至2033年。
克伦克和他的儿子乔什——两人同为联合主席——在五月阿森纳本赛季最后一场比赛结束后，在塞尔赫斯特公园举起英超奖杯并将其交给队长马丁·厄德高之前，显然非常享受这一时刻。他们曾因“像投资工具一样经营俱乐部”而受到批评，如今却因其产生的巨大影响而受到称赞。小克伦克承诺“本赛季结束后不会停滞不前”，考虑到KSE在美国多项运动中以连续获胜著称，这对他们的对手来说是一个不祥的预兆。
米克尔·阿尔特塔预计将获得丰厚的新合同续约——这将使他成为世界上薪酬最高的主教练之一——但尚未得到确认，但他对事业的奉献毋庸置疑。上赛季，当曼城在伯恩茅斯面前崩溃时，这位西班牙人不敢观看，而当阿森纳确认夺冠时，他正在后花园“生火”。随着佩普·瓜迪奥拉的离去，阿尔特塔有机会建立自己的新王朝。
吉马良斯的到来是阿森纳的又一重大意向声明。这位前纽卡斯尔队长在泰恩赛德俘获了人心，之后他希望赢得更多奖杯，他将为已经储备充足的中场提供多种选择。除了减轻赖斯的负担，这位全能型28岁巴西中场能够胜任多种角色，从拖后组织核心到B2B中场破坏者。尽管阿尔特塔在拥有马丁·苏比门迪、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、厄德高和米克尔·梅里诺的情况下，如何选择使用吉马良斯还有待观察，但他的天赋只会增加阿森纳阵容的质量。
本赛季裁判已被指示在定位球时更加注意拉拽动作，因此看看这是否会对阿森纳产生影响将很有趣。在英超中，只有三支球队的非点球预期进球差高于阿森纳仅凭定位球的表现。
马克斯·道曼上赛季首次踏入成年足球领域，是一个破纪录的惊喜，迹象表明，这位16岁的小将在季前赛再次表现出色后，可能会得到更多机会。对阵赫罗纳时，他打入一粒精彩进球并送出一次助攻，完成了右路的最佳球员表现。由于萨卡和诺尼·马杜埃凯在世界杯归队后需要逐步恢复，道曼已准备好增加自己的英超首发次数——他上赛季最后一天对阵水晶宫时曾有过一次首发——并且应该更频繁地出现在杯赛中。
赖斯和萨卡抵达美国时感受到了漫长赛季的影响，但他们带伤作战并坚持到了英格兰队的第八场比赛，这值得高度赞扬。只有托马斯·图赫尔知道为什么他在半决赛对阿根廷的比赛中将萨卡放在替补席上，而几天后他却在季军赛中上演帽子戏法，展示了即使有跟腱问题，他依然火力十足。两人在回归艰苦的俱乐部足球之前都需要一段较长的休息时间，阿森纳会尽可能地给他们时间。但他们实在太重要了，所以回归会比预想的更快。

bodyEn: The Arsenal manager, Mikel Arteta, has backed “warrior” Bruno Guimarães to “ignite something different” in the Premier League champions. The Brazil midfielder was introduced to fans ahead of Sunday’s 3-2 defeat by Borussia Dortmund in the Emirates Cup after completing his £75m move from Newcastle.
The 28-year-old, who has signed a four-year deal, bolsters a midfield which already includes Declan Rice, Martin Ødegaard, Mikel Merino, Martín Zubimendi and Eberechi Eze.

“You can see the immediate reaction,” Arteta told the club website after Guimarães was given a warm reception by supporters. “I think he describes himself as a warrior. I think he’s a warrior with a tremendous quality as well, and intuition and leadership and charisma that is going to help us. That is going to really ignite something different in the team. I think he’s going to push everybody inside the team as well and that’s the type of player that we need.”

After finishing runners-up for three successive seasons, Arsenal ended their 22-year wait for the Premier League title last term, in addition to reaching the Champions League and Carabao Cup finals. Guimarães watched on against Dortmund as an Ethan Nwaneri strike and a Viktor Gyökeres penalty were not enough to prevent defeat.
Samuele Inácio, Konstantinos Karetsas and Joane Gadou scored for the Bundesliga side at the Emirates Stadium, before Arsenal won a pre-arranged penalty shootout 5-4.

“Disappointed that we lost the game,” said Arteta, who gave Ødegaard his first minutes of pre-season following the World Cup and will welcome back his full squad on Monday. “I think there were some poor moments where we were not very recognisable, especially in set-pieces and defending actions and timings that we are normally very efficient [in].

“Some other very, very positive attacking combinations, big chances that didn’t finish in anything because of the final pass because they were completely open. But, overall, disappointed because you want to win the games in any context and today, we haven’t managed to do that.”

The Manchester City manager, Enzo Maresca, praised the impact of his wide players after Antoine Semenyo supplied ⁠assists for Omar Marmoush in a 3-1 victory over Atlético Madrid to wrap up their preseason tour ⁠of Asia.

Marmoush scored ⁠twice in ​the space of three minutes early in the second half before substitute Rayan Aït-Nouri added a third in stoppage ⁠time, helping City overturn a half-time deficit in front of more than 50,000 fans at Seoul World Cup Stadium.

items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔称吉马良斯为战士，相信他能点燃球队新火花。
bodyZh: 阿森纳主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔支持“战士”布鲁诺·吉马良斯在英超冠军球队中“点燃不同的东西”。这位巴西中场在完成从纽卡斯尔转会而来的7500万英镑交易后，于周日酋长杯3-2负于多特蒙德的比赛前被介绍给球迷。
这位28岁的球员签下了一份为期四年的合同，增强了本已拥有德克兰·赖斯、马丁·厄德高、米克尔·梅里诺、马丁·苏比门迪和埃贝雷奇·埃泽的中场阵容。
“你可以看到即时的反应，”阿尔特塔在吉马良斯受到球迷热烈欢迎后告诉俱乐部网站。“我认为他把自己描述为一名战士。我认为他是一名拥有出色技术、直觉、领导力和魅力的战士，这将帮助我们。这真的会在球队中点燃不同的东西。我认为他也会推动队内每个人，这就是我们需要的那种球员。”
在连续三个赛季获得亚军后，阿森纳在上赛季结束了长达22年的英超冠军等待，此外还打进了欧冠和联赛杯决赛。吉马良斯在对阵多特蒙德的比赛中目睹了伊桑·恩瓦内里的进球和维克托·约克雷斯的点球不足以阻止失败。
萨穆埃尔·伊纳西奥、康斯坦丁诺斯·卡雷察斯和乔恩·加杜为德甲球队在酋长球场进球，随后阿森纳在预先安排的点球大战中以5-4获胜。
“很失望我们输掉了比赛，”阿尔特塔说，他给了厄德高世界杯后季前赛的首秀机会，并将于周一迎回完整阵容。“我认为有一些糟糕的时刻，我们不太像自己，尤其是在定位球、防守动作和时间安排上，这些通常是我们非常高效的方面。”
“还有一些非常非常积极的进攻组合，创造了巨大机会，但因为最后一传而一无所获，因为他们完全开放。但总的来说，很失望，因为你希望在任何情况下都赢球，而今天我们没有做到。”
曼城主教练恩佐·马雷斯卡赞扬了他的边锋球员在3-1战胜马德里竞技的比赛中产生的影响，安托万·塞梅尼奥为奥马尔·马尔穆什提供了助攻，结束了他们的亚洲季前巡回赛。
马尔穆什在下半场初段三分钟内梅开二度，随后替补出场的拉扬·艾特-努里在补时阶段再入一球，帮助曼城在首尔世界杯体育场超过5万名球迷面前逆转了半场落后的局面。

“我们需要临门一脚。这是我们需要改进的地方，”他说。“我们正在慢慢做到这一点，有埃尔林（哈兰德）我们会更具威胁。今天奥马尔进了两球。这是一种鼓舞。”

bodyEn: If there was one of his many assets Newcastle supporters grew to love above all about Bruno Guimarães then it was best summed up by the man himself after being unveiled as Arsenal’s new £75m signing. “That’s a tough one,” said the Brazil midfielder when asked what fans in north London can expect from him. “I would say I can pass the ball, run a lot and play like a warrior. I’ll never give up.”

After more than four years on Tyneside and having seen Alexander Isak, Anthony Gordon and Sandro Tonali precede Eddie Howe’s departure, Guimarães – who was devastated after missing a penalty for the Seleção in their defeat against Norway in the last 16 of the World Cup – was determined to seize his opportunity.

While his emotional statement released by Newcastle as his move to Arsenal was confirmed on Saturday said they “did everything they could to keep me”, at the age of 28 he clearly felt it may never come again.

Andrea Berta’s pursuit of Vinícius Júnior came up short this week after the Brazil forward signed an improved six-year deal with Real Madrid. But at least Arsenal’s sporting director was finally able to bring in a player who was first courted by the club in the early days of Mikel Arteta’s reign, and who will add to the outstanding crop of central midfielders at his disposal.

Edu Gaspar, Berta’s predecessor, is understood to have first enquired about Guimarães when he was still at Athletico Paranaense in Brazil before he joined Lyon in the January 2020 transfer window – a few weeks after Arteta’s arrival at the Emirates.

They were also interested when Newcastle won the race to sign him in January 2022 for €40m, which came back to haunt Arsenal when he scored in a 2-0 win that went a long way to them missing out on Champions League qualification that season.

That first of nine appearances is the only time he scored against Arsenal, but Guimarães always impressed in a variety of roles whenever he came up against them, including in the Carabao Cup semi-final Newcastle won 4-0 on aggregate in 2025. He has covered more distance, won more duels and committed more fouls against Arsenal than any other side since making his Premier League debut.

It was no surprise that Declan Rice – the only player in the division to have covered more distance than Guimarães in that period and who enjoyed their fair share of battles – was one of the first to welcome him to Arsenal with a message that said “come here and please no more fights, now we’re friends”.

It is hard to argue with Guimarães that Arsenal have “one of the best midfields” in Europe because last season proved it. Yet having gone all the way to the Champions League final before spending the summer with England, after suffering with neural pain in his hamstring and lower back since December, Rice must be treated with the utmost care in the coming months. Guimarães can provide cover for him in a box-to-box role and gives Arteta options to rotate his other midfielders more frequently.

He did not seem to trust Christian Nørgaard, who has joined Everton, to deputise for Martín Zubimendi in the Premier League last year, and that led to the Spain midfielder running out of steam in the spring.

It was telling that the teenager Myles Lewis-Skelly started in his preferred position at the base of midfield during the title run-in, and against Paris Saint-Germain in Budapest for the Champions League final, having begun the campaign as a left-back. Guimarães showed at Newcastle he is capable of playing in a deeper role as well and Arteta must decide how to balance his plethora of options in a crucial part of the pitch.

While he could not match Mikel Merino’s goalscoring exploits for Spain,Martin Ødegaard showed signs that he is back to his best during the World Cup after another disappointing season for Arsenal that was again interrupted by injury.

Having missed out on Morgan Rogers, the onus will be on the Norway captain, Guimarães and last summer’s big signing, Eberechi Eze, to provide some creativity to an attack that struggled to break down the low block at times last season.

Arsenal are still in the market for a defender to cover the absence of William Saliba for an extended period, while they would like to bring in another forward to add to the signing of Christos Tzolis. Atlético Madrid’s Julián Alvarez or Bradley Barcola of Paris Saint-Germain would fit the bill, although it remains to be seen if they will bring in a marquee player without offloading Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus – who has interest from Napoli. Even if they do depart, the presence of another familiar face in the Brazil centre-back Gabriel should also help Guimarães settle into his new home.

“Big Gabi was very excited,” he told Arsenal’s website. “Every time he sent me the message: ‘We’ll wait for you, when will you come?’ I’m so excited to join them, not only the Brazilians, we have an amazing squad here. I’m so excited to meet the other players, to start training. I just want to give my best.”

items.summaryZh: 吉马良斯既能胜任更深位置，也需为攻坚低防守的锋线提供创造力。数据显示这笔交易或为定位球又一妙手。
bodyZh: 如果纽卡斯尔球迷最喜爱布鲁诺·吉马良斯的众多特质中有一项最为突出，那最好由他本人来总结——在他正式亮相为阿森纳7500万英镑新援之后。“这是个难题，”当被问到北伦敦球迷能对他有何期待时，这位巴西中场说道。“我会说我能传球、跑动很多，并且像战士一样战斗。我永远不会放弃。”
在泰恩赛德度过四年多，目睹亚历山大·伊萨克、安东尼·戈登和桑德罗·托纳利在埃迪·豪离队前相继离开后，吉马良斯——在世界杯16强赛巴西负于挪威时罚失点球而备受打击——决心抓住机会。
尽管纽卡斯尔在上周六确认他转会阿森纳时发布的动情声明称他们“为留下我做了一切”，但在28岁的年纪，他显然觉得这样的机会可能不会再有了。
安德烈亚·贝尔塔追逐维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔本周落空，这位巴西前锋与皇马签下了一份为期六年的改进合同。但至少阿森纳体育总监终于能够引进一名在米克尔·阿尔特塔执教初期就被俱乐部追求的球员，他将为阿尔特塔手中出众的中场球员储备增添力量。
据悉，贝尔塔的前任埃杜·加斯帕尔最早在吉马良斯还在巴西的巴拉纳竞技时就曾询价过他，随后他在2020年1月转会窗加入里昂——那是在阿尔特塔抵达酋长球场几周之后。
当纽卡斯尔在2022年1月以4000万欧元赢得签下他的竞争时，阿森纳也曾有意。这最终让阿森纳后悔不已，因为他在一场2-0的胜利中进球，那场胜利很大程度上导致枪手那个赛季无缘欧冠资格。
他在对阵阿森纳的首次（也是唯一一次）进球出现在九次交锋中的第一场，但吉马良斯每次与阿森纳交手时都在不同角色中给人留下深刻印象，包括2025年纽卡斯尔以4-0总比分赢得的联赛杯半决赛。自他英超首秀以来，他对阵阿森纳时的跑动距离、赢得对抗次数和犯规次数都超过对阵其他任何球队。
毫无疑问，德克兰·赖斯——英超中唯一一位在该时期跑动距离超过吉马良斯的球员，并且两人有过不少交锋——是最早欢迎他加盟阿森纳的人之一，他发消息说：“来这里吧，请不要再打架了，现在我们已经是朋友了。”
很难反驳吉马良斯所说阿森纳拥有欧洲“最佳中场之一”的论断，因为上赛季证明了这一点。然而，赖斯一路踢到欧冠决赛，随后整个夏天随英格兰队度过，自12月以来一直饱受腿筋和下背部的神经疼痛困扰，未来几个月必须以最大限度的谨慎对待他。吉马良斯可以在B2B角色中为他提供掩护，并让阿尔特塔有更多轮换其他中场球员的选择。
上赛季他似乎并不信任已加盟埃弗顿的克里斯蒂安·诺尔高来为马丁·苏比门迪担任替补，这导致这位西班牙中场在春季体能透支。

值得注意的一点是，小将迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利在争冠冲刺阶段以及布达佩斯对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的欧冠决赛中，都在他偏爱的中场底部位置首发——尽管他赛季初是作为左后卫出场的。吉马良斯在纽卡斯尔证明了他也能胜任更深的位置，阿尔特塔必须决定如何在这一关键区域平衡他的众多选择。
尽管他无法与米克尔·梅里诺在西班牙队的进球表现相提并论，但在又一个因伤病中断的令人失望的阿森纳赛季之后，马丁·厄德高在世界杯期间显示出他正在回归最佳状态的迹象。
在错失摩根·罗杰斯之后，压力落在了挪威队长、吉马良斯以及去年夏天的大手笔引援埃贝雷奇·埃泽身上，他们需要为上赛季有时难以攻破低位防线的进攻提供创造力。

阿森纳仍在转会市场上寻找一名后卫以覆盖威廉·萨利巴长期缺阵的情况，同时他们希望再引进一名前锋，作为签下克里斯托斯·佐利斯的补充。马德里竞技的胡利安·阿尔瓦雷斯或巴黎圣日耳曼的布拉德利·巴尔科拉都符合要求，不过在没有出售加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯（那不勒斯对他有意）的情况下是否会引进一名顶级球星，仍有待观察。即使他们离开，另一张熟悉面孔——巴西中卫加布里埃尔的存在也应该有助于吉马良斯融入新家。
“大加比非常兴奋，”他告诉阿森纳官网。“每次他给我发消息：‘我们等你，你什么时候来？’我很高兴加入他们，不仅仅是巴西人，我们这里有一支很棒的球队。我很期待见到其他球员，开始训练。我只想全力以赴。”

bodyEn: Bruno Guimarães has broken a very niche record. His £75m move to Arsenal is the most expensive transfer for a midfielder aged at least 28. This should not be taken too seriously given the previous record holder, Zinedine Zidane, moved 25 years ago from Juventus to Real Madrid, and would have cost far more in 2026 money. But it shows how highly the Gunners rate the Brazilian to have spent so much on a player who will be in his 30s before the end of next year. It is a transfer for today, not tomorrow.

The question is why. One reason is that Guimarães rarely misses matches. Another is that he can play anywhere across midfield in the 4-3-3 formation Mikel Arteta often deploys. These attributes could be priceless with Declan Rice managing long-term nerve pain in his hamstring and Martin Ødegaard playing 40% of possible Premier League minutes last season.

The former Newcastle player is adept at breaking up attacks. Opta’s data shows Arsenal misplaced 1,492 passes in the final third last season, the fourth most in the Premier League. That is a lot of potential opportunities for the opposition to hit them on the break.

Guimarães is unafraid to give away a free-kick if required. He was penalised for 45 fouls in the league last season, a mark he hit in all four of his full campaigns with Newcastle. Only Moisés Caicedo also reached that level in each of the previous four Premier League seasons.

Despite committing the fourth-most fouls in the competition since making his debut for Newcastle in February 2022, nine players have received more yellow cards than Guimarães in that time. Not all indiscretions are equal, but referees seem to view him favourably.

They are even nicer on the other side of the foul equation. Guimarães excels in winning free-kicks. He has suffered 410 fouls in the Premier League, more than 100 more than anyone else during his time in England.

Look around other top European leagues, at competitions where referees are quicker to award a foul than they are in England. Aside from the Lazio winger Mattia Zaccagni (with 418), you will not find anyone who has won more free-kicks than Guimarães. Vinicius Júnior is a shade above him on a pro-rata basis, with 2.95 fouls drawn per 90 minutes to 2.89, and Arsenal were trying to sign him too.

Guimarães ranked no lower than second in the Premier League for fouls suffered in each of the previous four seasons, twice leading the standings for England, France, Germany, Italy and Spain. This will have been an enticing selling point for a team that spin so much gold from set plays. And here’s the ultimate win from Arsenal’s perspective: only two players have scored more set-piece goals than Guimarães in the Premier League since early 2022 and they already own one of them.
His 12 goals is the joint-most by a midfielder or forward. By moving to Arsenal he has linked up with one of the defenders above him, his fellow Brazilian Gabriel.

The 28-year-old is not the only big loss to Newcastle this summer. Sandro Tonali and Anthony Gordon were vital players and also in Newcastle’s top four for free-kicks won last season. But their combined foul total was less than Guimarães’s and neither scored from a set piece either.
For a team that plays the wayArsenal do, this particular set of skills may just be worth £75m, even for a relative veteran.

items.summaryZh: 巴西人擅长制造任意球并借此创造机会，因此枪手愿花7500万英镑。
bodyZh: 布鲁诺·吉马良斯打破了一项非常小众的纪录。他以7500万英镑转会阿森纳，成为28岁及以上中场球员中最昂贵的转会。鉴于此前纪录保持者齐内丁·齐达内是在25年前从尤文图斯转会皇家马德里，若按2026年的市值计算，其转会费会高得多，因此这项纪录不必太当真。但这表明枪手对这位巴西球员的评价之高，以至于愿意为一位明年年底前将年过30的球员花这么多钱。这是一笔为当下而非未来的引援。
问题是为什么。原因之一是吉马良斯很少缺席比赛。另一个原因是，在米克尔·阿尔特塔经常布置的4-3-3阵型中，他可以胜任中场任何位置。在德克兰·赖斯需要应对腿筋长期神经疼痛、以及马丁·厄德高上赛季仅出战英超可能的40%比赛时间的情况下，这些特质可谓无价。
这位前纽卡斯尔球员擅长破坏对手进攻。Opta数据显示，阿森纳上赛季在对方禁区前30米区域传球失误1492次，为英超第四多。这给对手留下了大量反击的潜在机会。
吉马良斯在需要时毫不畏惧送出任意球。上赛季他在联赛中被判犯规45次，这也是他效力纽卡斯尔的四个完整赛季中都达到的数字。在过去的四个英超赛季中，只有莫伊塞斯·凯塞多也每个赛季都达到这一水平。
尽管自2022年2月为纽卡斯尔首秀以来，他在联赛中犯规次数位列第四多，但同期有九名球员比吉马良斯吃到更多黄牌。并非所有犯规都同等对待，但裁判似乎对他印象不错。
而在犯规方程式的另一侧，他们甚至更为友好。吉马良斯非常擅长赢得任意球。他在英超共被犯规410次，在英格兰效力期间，这一数字比任何其他球员都高出100多次。
放眼其他欧洲顶级联赛，那些裁判比英格兰更易判罚犯规的赛事。除了拉齐奥边锋马蒂亚·扎卡尼（418次）之外，没有人比吉马良斯赢得更多任意球。维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔按比例略高于他，每90分钟造犯规2.95次对2.89次，而阿森纳也曾想签下他。
在过去四个赛季中，吉马良斯在英超被犯规次数上从未低于第二，两次在英格兰、法国、德国、意大利和西班牙的联赛中领跑。对于一支如此擅长从定位球中获益的球队来说，这无疑是一个诱人的卖点。而从阿森纳的角度看，最极致的胜利在于：自2022年初以来，英超只有两名球员的定位球进球数多于吉马良斯，而他们已拥有其中一位。
他打入的12粒进球与中场或前锋的最高进球数持平。转会阿森纳后，他与排在他之前的后卫之一——同为巴西人的加布里埃尔——联手了。
这位28岁的球员并不是纽卡斯尔今夏唯一的重大损失。桑德罗·托纳利和安东尼·戈登都是关键球员，也在纽卡斯尔上赛季赢得任意球次数最多的前四名之列。但他们两人的犯规总数加起来都比吉马良斯少，而且两人都没有通过定位球得分。
对于一支像阿森纳这样踢球的球队来说，这套特殊技能或许就值7500万英镑，即使面对一位相对而言的老将也是如此。
